core_reason: The sum of absolute diagonal entries dominates each negative diagonal magnitude. Therefore adding c=sum_i |K_ii| makes every diagonal entry nonnegative, while off-diagonal entries are unchanged by the diagonal shift.
calculation: For i != j, (cI+K)_ij = K_ij, so off-diagonal nonnegativity is preserved.
For i = j, (cI+K)_ii = K_ii + c, which is nonnegative.
